headline: TBR @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 3.60 at TOR 3.79, with a projected total of 7.40. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TOR: TBR moved -0.39 runs while TOR moved -0.08, changing the projected margin by -0.30 runs. The projected total fell -0.47, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Griffin Jax has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Kazuma Okamoto, Chandler Simpson, Jonathan Aranda, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Davis Schneider because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
